slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video behind centered headline; object-cover, autoplay/muted/playsInline with a bottom-to-dark fade overlay.
Dark full-bleed background image for the TrustedSection (cover/center) sitting behind the four ServiceCards, with a bottom white fade.
Light full-bleed background image for the PrecisionSection staircase (cover/center/no-repeat).
HLS-streamed (hls.js, .m3u8) video cropped into a perfect circle in the center column of the FreedomSection; scaled to 160% and centered, autoplay/loop/muted/playsInline, Safari native-HLS fallback.
Decorative top-layer image revealed on ServiceCard hover (object-cover, object-position top); shared across all four cards, fades/slides in from translateY(-30%) opacity 0.7 to full.
Check-style list-bullet glyph used as a CSS background-image on positive rows (FreedomSection right column) and on ServiceCard bullets; accent-purple tinted.
Cross-style list-bullet glyph used as a CSS background-image on the negative rows in the FreedomSection left column.
Small brand logo mark shown inside each of the four PrecisionSection pillar chips (width ~1.111vw), repeated across all pillars.
Custom display/body typeface ('Mazzard H') loaded via @font-face in two weights (400 body, 500 headings) and applied globally to html/body/*.

mechanic: Fixed pill navbar that narrows on scroll above a fullscreen looping hero video, leading into stacked dark/light background-image sections of hover-revealing ServiceCards, a circular HLS video flanked by negative/positive cross-vs-check rows, and a vw-positioned four-pillar 'staircase' with gradient connector lines.
techDelivery: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind 3.4 (PostCSS/Autoprefixer), with lucide-react icons and hls.js for HLS streaming; per-component .tsx files, fonts via @font-face in src/index.css.
reskinNotes: Brand colors are baked as literal rgb()/hex inside multiple inline SVGs (navbar logo gradient, the four ServiceCard dot icons, the Control and Structured-Delivery chip glyphs) and into a six-stop CSS gradient for the pillar connector line, so re-tinting requires editing SVG/markup rather than swapping a token. Two multi-stop brand gradients (A for logos/buttons, B for headline highlights) are reused via background-clip:text and must be recreated. All copy is hardcoded in JSX. The PrecisionSection desktop staircase uses hardcoded vw-based absolute left/bottom offsets and whitespace-nowrap headlines, making layout sensitive to font metrics and copy length; md:whitespace-nowrap on the hero H1 is likewise length-fragile.
